checks.name: empty today and add
checks.detail: the empty Today screen offered Add a habit; naming one put it on the checklist with its schedule label

checks.name: skip, unskip, complete
checks.detail: Skip marked the row Skipped; tapping a skipped row undid the skip (plain schedule label again) and the next tap completed it

checks.name: edit screen
checks.detail: rename (prefilled entry, saved as read more), schedule change to every 2 days, archive shown as archived on Manage, and put back restored the habit

checks.name: weekly summary with seeded history
checks.detail: a seeded daily habit (3 done, 1 skipped in the window) plus the session habit summed to 'This week: 3 of 10 due days completed, 1 skipped.' under a 4 completions heading

checks.name: backup export
checks.detail: Settings offered Export a backup; the export flow prepared a verified text copy and announced it ready for the paired computer, with the offer saved in the app store

checks.name: persistence across restart
checks.detail: after a simulator restart the seeded habit was due on Today and the session habit kept its renamed, rescheduled self
